title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Mango Sticky Rice is a dish from Thailand prepared with glutinous rice, coconut milk, mango, white sesame seeds. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Use glutinous sticky rice; regular jasmine rice is not a suitable substitute.

steps.instruction: Soak the measured rice or noodles in clean cool water for about 240 minutes, then drain and proceed to the specified cooking step.
Steam the already prepared parcels or mixture over gently boiling water for approximately 30 minutes, until fully cooked or set.
Warm coconut milk with palm sugar and salt, then pour most of it over the freshly steamed sticky rice; cover and let absorb before serving.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
